title: SKAM Italia
tagline: Millennials experience first love and discover their emerging identities in this
synopsis: Millennials experience first love and discover their emerging identities in this teen drama told partly through texts, chats and social media posts.

episodes.title: You look like a wh*re
episodes.synopsis: Eva moved with her boyfriend Giovanni to the high school headquarters. Will they start new friendships? Meanwhile, something is disturbing her.

episodes.title: You're an a**hole
episodes.synopsis: Eva spends Easter at the lake with Giovanni. The weekend isn't what she imagined because they're not alone. What does the message on his cell mean?

episodes.title: A party where nobody wants you
episodes.synopsis: Eva finally met some of the girls at school. All it took was an evening of hanging out together, and they hit it off. A new group of friends is born!

episodes.title: Does your boyfriend know we text each other?
episodes.synopsis: How will Silvia get to know Edoardo, the coolest guy in school? Sana has a plan! First she needs to get herself invited to the big party.

episodes.title: What turns you on?
episodes.synopsis: What will the first time be like? Silvia talks about it with Eva and Eleonora. Eva goes to the party with her friends, forgetting about Giovanni.

episodes.title: Laura told me everything
episodes.synopsis: Eva discovers Giovanni is hiding something from her. Silvia seems really into Edoardo, but he ignores her and Sana tries to get her to open her eyes.

episodes.title: I made a mess
episodes.synopsis: Eva, regretting having kissed Federico at the party, confides in Martino. At school rumors fly; Silvia has had enough and decides to face Edoardo.

episodes.title: Everyone at school knows
episodes.synopsis: Giovanni discovers that Eva kissed Federico and doesn't want to talk to her anymore. Alone and judged by everyone, she tries to resolve things.

episodes.title: If you all hate me so much
episodes.synopsis: Silvia reveals a secret which creates tension among the girls. Meanwhile, Eva tries to face her problems, but she makes an incredible discovery.

episodes.title: Why did you do something like that to me?
episodes.synopsis: Eva tries to understand why Martino betrayed her. Silvia is in trouble with the others, but soon she has the proof that their friendship isn't over.

episodes.title: A stupid choice
episodes.synopsis: Eva has to make a decision: what will she do with Giovanni? The end-of-year party arrives with excitement, promise and an unexpected discovery...

episodes.title: I've never seen you before
episodes.synopsis: It's the start of the new school year. Due to an unexpected incident, Martino is stuck with the group that runs the radio, but a surprise awaits him.

episodes.title: No result
episodes.synopsis: Martino is struck by the encounter with Niccolò and tries to find out about him. Meanwhile, he avoids Emma, who would like to get to know him better.

episodes.title: Manhood
episodes.synopsis: Giovanni and Elia criticize Martino and he lies about his friendship with Niccolò. He tries to patch it up with Emma, but his thoughts are elsewhere.

episodes.title: Holding your breath
episodes.synopsis: It's almost Halloween and Martino decides to go to a costume party with Niccolò, Emma and Maddalena. The evening has an unexpected twist...

episodes.title: The last man on Earth
episodes.synopsis: The intense situation with Niccolò has led Martino to neglect his friends again. He's not truthful about it, and discovers a sad truth.

episodes.title: City-Real
episodes.synopsis: Martino is confused about Niccolò and struggles to talk about it with his friends. Some unexpected advice moves him to a possible solution.

episodes.title: The love wizard
episodes.synopsis: For Martino the time has come to clear things up with Giovanni and the others. Will a trip to the lake be enough to resolve their issues?

episodes.title: Have a nice trip
episodes.synopsis: Martino is finally living his love for Niccolò, determined not to worry about anything. Maddalena looks to make contact, but the boys decide to leave.

episodes.title: Madness
episodes.synopsis: Niccolò's situation is a hard reality for Martino. Yet his feelings run deep and he needs to understand. Giovanni, Elia and Luca stay close to him.

episodes.title: Minute by minute
episodes.synopsis: Martino is ready to take things with Niccolò day by day. Meanwhile, Christmas is coming and someone returns to the city...

episodes.title: Go out with me
episodes.synopsis: After almost a year, Edoardo still wants to go out with Eleonora, but he always gets shot down. Silvia receives an unexpected message on her cell.

episodes.title: It's you
episodes.synopsis: It comes out that Edoardo was with a girl when his friends were attacked. Someone figures out Eleonora's secret, and she needs to tell Silvia.

episodes.title: Tell him I'm coming back tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: Eleonora hasn't faced Silvia yet and is worried. The situation gets complicated at Edoardo's party. Eva discovers an unexpected secret about Giovanni.

episodes.title: That's why I don't like you
episodes.synopsis: Edoardo and his friends organize a fundraising evening with a raffle. What's the first prize up for grabs? Eleonora will not be happy to find out...

episodes.title: I will never hurt you
episodes.synopsis: Eleonora wants to drop her defenses and welcome her feelings. After meeting Andrea, Edoardo's brother, something leaves her unexpectedly disturbed.

episodes.title: Enough
episodes.synopsis: Eleonora, Eva, Silvia, Sana and Federica are excited about the evening festivities, but it suddenly turns ugly due to a terrible unforeseen event.

episodes.title: Brothers
episodes.synopsis: After the Easter party, Eleonora is left confused and confides in Sana, who urges her to talk with Silvia. Is this the moment of truth?

episodes.title: Oops
episodes.synopsis: Eleonora doesn't remember what happened with Andrea the previous evening. While waiting to clear things up with him, Edoardo tries again with her.

episodes.title: Fever
episodes.synopsis: Shocked by the photo she received from Andrea, Eleonora isolates herself at home. Edoardo tries to stay close, unaware of her fear she's been raped.

episodes.title: Tell me too
episodes.synopsis: Eleonora finally finds an explanation for what happened with Andrea. Will she win back Edoardo's love or have to give up on him forever?

episodes.title: Three, two, one
episodes.synopsis: For Eleonora it's time to reveal her past. A video shot on the evening of the Easter party puts Edoardo and the others at risk.

episodes.title: Italian
episodes.synopsis: Sana's brother Rami arranges an outing with Eva, Silvia, Federica and her friends. Sana risks her two different worlds becoming mixed up and confused.

episodes.title: Mykonos
episodes.synopsis: Chicco offers Sana and the others an expensive solution for summer vacation: A villa with a pool in Mykonos. Even the hated UFBs are interested...

episodes.title: Too bad
episodes.synopsis: Sana must find a way to scrape together the deposit for the villa. She is increasingly attracted to Malik, but she ignores one very important thing.

episodes.title: Total eclipse
episodes.synopsis: Sana invites the UFBs to Mykonos so the expenses for the villa can be shared, and the two groups begin to bond, as do Sana and Malik.

episodes.title: Alpha males
episodes.synopsis: Sana feels left out by her friends who are now increasingly attached to the UFBs. Rami convinces her to ignore their parents' advice and let loose.

episodes.title: Your friend
episodes.synopsis: Sana decides not to go to Mykonos. In the meantime, she tries to get Eva back with her ex to nip her friend's relationship with Malik in the bud.

episodes.title: Stupid questions
episodes.synopsis: Sana and Martino discuss their respective relationships, after he leaves Niccolò out of jealousy. Malik insists on contacting Sana.

episodes.title: The losers
episodes.synopsis: Sana apologizes to her friends and finds out Eva and Malik are dating for different reasons than she imagined. Martino tries to curb his jealousy.

episodes.title: Close your eyes
episodes.synopsis: With her mother's help, Sana realizes that her choice of faith can coexist with her love life and she decides to write to Malik.

episodes.title: Together
episodes.synopsis: Adulthood draws near. While new relationships are born and others flourish, Sana and the others enjoy the last days of their adolescence.

episodes.title: As usual
episodes.synopsis: Elia gets close to Alessia while at a bar with his friends. The band practices for their performance but runs into a problem.

episodes.title: Baran
episodes.synopsis: Elia turns to his dad for financial help when Filippo pressures him for rent money. Viola reminds Elia of a memory from their past.

episodes.title: Mister Kennedy
episodes.synopsis: Without reading their platform, Elia agrees to join Viola and her friends in their campaign. Later, Elia has an anxious moment in the locker room.

episodes.title: Free love
episodes.synopsis: Luchino and the band disagree when they get invited to play at a fundraising event for the group that wants to shut down their friends' radio station.

episodes.title: Never
episodes.synopsis: Elia's growing fear of sexual inadequacy begins to affect his relationship with Viola and his mood, and his friends take notice.

episodes.title: Anniversary
episodes.synopsis: Elia schemes to bring Asia and Sana together to discuss a solution to the radio station. Viola reacts to Elia's attempts to apologize.

episodes.title: A bigger one
episodes.synopsis: A rumor about Elia spreads at his school, so he confronts who he thinks is responsible. When Viola pays him a visit, she tells him a shocking secret.

episodes.title: Am I wrong?
episodes.synopsis: Elia faces his fears and takes a step forward toward his self-acceptance. Meanwhile, Spera's dark past starts to surface.

episodes.title: Undress
episodes.synopsis: Viola and Federica join forces to go to the police. The results of the school election are announced. Elia and Viola rekindle their relationship.

episodes.title: Our adventure
episodes.synopsis: The gang organizes a party to commemorate the last radio show. The school psychologist offers Elia some advice, which helps him overcome his anxiety.
